title: Gentle DNA helix motion on Start Dashboard (Tailwind + reduced-motion aware)

requirements.summary: Add a subtle continuous helix “breathing/drift” motion to the HelixSpine visuals without impacting factor marker readability or layout.
acceptanceCriteria: The helix spine in `frontend/src/components/genome/HelixSpine.tsx` visibly animates with a subtle motion (e.g., slow drift/phase or breathing) while the factor markers remain readable and do not jitter.
The animation is continuous and smooth (no abrupt looping) and feels “scientific” (low amplitude, slow tempo).
The animation does not change layout flow (no reflow that moves the markers’ vertical spacing/positions).

file_operations.description: Scope the new helix motion to only the SVG visuals (strands/base-pairs) by grouping them into motion layers (e.g., <g> wrappers) and applying low-amplitude Tailwind animation utilities; ensure the factor markers container remains unaffected and z-index layering remains intact (no layout-affecting changes).

requirements.summary: Respect reduced-motion preferences by disabling (or making imperceptible) the helix motion while keeping marker interactions unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: If the user has `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, the helix motion is disabled (or reduced to an imperceptible/static state).
All other dashboard interactions (hover/focus/selection on factor markers) continue to work normally with reduced motion enabled.

file_operations.description: Apply Tailwind motion variants so helix animation runs only under motion-safe (e.g., motion-safe:animate-...) and is disabled under reduced motion (e.g., motion-reduce:animate-none / motion-reduce:transform-none), without changing any FactorMarker interaction handlers or focus styles.

requirements.summary: Implement the helix motion via existing Tailwind setup (keyframes/animation utilities) and keep it strictly scoped to helix visuals and the genome theme.
acceptanceCriteria: Tailwind animation utilities/keyframes are added/extended in `frontend/tailwind.config.js` and/or `frontend/src/index.css` (consistent with the project’s current Tailwind + OKLCH theming).
The animation is applied in a scoped way (helix visuals only), without affecting the header/footer or overall page background color theme.
No changes are made to files listed as immutable by the system context (e.g., `frontend/src/main.tsx`, Internet Identity hooks, or `frontend/src/components/ui/*`).

file_operations.description: Extend Tailwind with helix-specific keyframes/animation utilities (slow tempo, low amplitude drift/breathing; optionally include a phased variant via delay) intended for SVG transforms/opacity only; keep additions consistent with the existing OKLCH genome theme tokens.

Add small, helix-scoped utility helpers (in @layer utilities) to ensure SVG transform behavior is stable and non-jittery (e.g., consistent transform-origin/transform-box and will-change) for the helix motion classes only, without affecting global page background/header/footer styling.
